description: Import memories from a JSON array or a .json file inside data/exports/. Validates type, dedupes against existing memories, and never overwrites active memory blindly. Dry-run by default; pass apply=true to insert.

apply.description: Actually insert memories (default false = dry run, just report)

file.description: Path to a .json export file (must be inside data/exports/)

json.description: Inline JSON: an array of memory objects, or { memories: [...] }

trusted.description: Trusted import (default false). Auxiliary data (preferences/lessons/profile) is restored only when true; per-item trusted flags are ignored

userId.description: Scope imported memories to a user (USER scope); overrides per-item userId

name: import_memory
title: Import memories
